method:
Production camera/UI checks on an isolated origin. Synthetic saves, real input.
Normal RAF is used for WASD and orbit; command walking is accelerated explicitly.
Software WebGL coverage is not a human comfort or GPU performance claim.

checks.name: Fresh world defaults to true perspective
Four visible camera choices
Right drag orbits without issuing movement
Wheel changes distance without FOV pumping
Real W input walks forward relative to the camera
Orbit changes real WASD world direction
Sky click is ignored without an invalid path or error
Visible FOV control changes production projection
Settings select retains overhead view
Mode and FOV survive actual origin reload
R returns to third person behind the character
follow camera control works
wide camera control works
adventure camera control works
Accepted route -11,-1.6
Actual house wall pulls the camera in before penetration
Camera returns after the wall clears
House entry preserves perspective with a finite eye
House exit retains third person
Accepted route 11,9
Reduced motion removes camera follow interpolation
Initial kit still obtained through visible interaction
Accepted route 15,7
Starter entry retains perspective and the saved FOV
Third-person quest labels stay nearby and do not overlap
Quest label setting is respected
Accepted route -7,3
Projected enemy body is visible
Clicking a visible body selects stationary autoattack
Combat still resolves through actual rules after selection
Perspective health indicators have bounded screen size
Modal equipment blocks walking and attacks
Rounded avatar renders in the equipment portrait
Portrait aspect keeps a finite perspective camera
Camera choices stay inside the narrow viewport
No unhandled browser errors
